title: Cross-platform execution
description: Keep native execution bounded by safe arguments, portable paths, and verified prerequisites.
purpose: Make behavior reliable across supported operating systems without guessing native details.
requirements: cross-platform-execution/native-boundary: Use the selected platform adapter for native execution and keep canonical rules free of paths, tools, and syntax tied to one product.
cross-platform-execution/safe-quoting: Quote arguments for the active platform, preserve Unicode and whitespace, and reject ambiguous or shell-interpreted input.
cross-platform-execution/prerequisites: Verify required runtimes, permissions, and capabilities before execution; report unsupported or unavailable prerequisites.
cross-platform-execution/paths: Canonicalize paths and confirm containment before reading or writing any destination.
invariants: Use native platform adapters, safe quoting, Unicode-safe paths, and verified prerequisites.
